#id: # ISO 13567-2 positional fields: agent (2), element (6), presentation (2),
# status (1), sector (4), phase (1), projection (1), scale (1), work
# package (2), user defined (21+). Unused optional fields are "-".
# Element: the Uniclass 2015 code without underscores, first 6 characters
# (as DMRB GG 184 does), "-" filled. Presentation E element, T text,
# H hatching, D dimensions, B border, U construction lines, G grid.
# No colours in ISO 13567: empty colour and lineweight cells keep the NLCS
# pen of the object; linetypes are ISO 128 dash patterns.
